project.name: Hypervelocity Engineering
project.summary: A toolkit that keeps requirements, the catalog and the tests of an app in step, and HVE Studio, the local web app that lets you see all of it and the code behind it.

nodes.label: HVE Studio screens
nodes.summary: The web pages in the browser: dashboards, maps, diagrams, tables and the code floorplan.

nodes.label: Frame and shared pieces
nodes.summary: The top bar, language and theme switches, search and the small widgets every screen shares.

nodes.label: Maps and diagrams
nodes.summary: Requirement maps and diagrams in 2D, 3D and graph form.

nodes.label: Progress and tables
nodes.summary: Dashboards, implementation status, tables, the source mapping and the task list.

nodes.label: Code maps
nodes.summary: The code floorplan and the network of function calls.

nodes.label: Look and feel
nodes.summary: Colours, spacing and type for light and dark themes.

nodes.label: Studio server
nodes.summary: A small local server that reads a repository and answers the screens. It only listens on this computer and never changes your files unless you confirm.

nodes.label: Reads the requirements
nodes.summary: Reads the requirement documents, catalog and test ledger and builds one model of them.

nodes.label: Reads the code
nodes.summary: Finds the functions, endpoints and imports in the source, and checks it for common mistakes.

nodes.label: Build kit scripts
nodes.summary: The commands that number requirements, check that documents, tests and catalog agree, and repair them.

nodes.label: Installer
nodes.summary: Copies the toolkit into another repository, updates it and removes it again.

nodes.label: Project story page
nodes.summary: A single web page that tells how the project came to be.

nodes.label: Spreadsheet sample
nodes.summary: A small sample program at the top of the repository.

nodes.label: Tests
nodes.summary: Everything that checks the rest.

nodes.label: Studio tests
nodes.summary: Checks the Studio server and every screen in a real browser.

nodes.label: Toolkit tests
nodes.summary: Checks the scripts and the installer.

nodes.label: System tests
nodes.summary: End-to-end checks of whole behaviours.

nodes.label: GitHub
nodes.summary: Where issues and pull requests live; Studio reads them when you ask.

nodes.label: Playwright browser
nodes.summary: A real browser the tests drive.

nodes.label: Git history
nodes.summary: The repository itself: which files exist and what changed.

edges.label: lists files and history
edges.description: Runs read-only git commands to see the files and the history.

annotations.note: The largest file: reads every kind of document and builds the model all screens use.
Every visible word, in Japanese and English. Add words here, never in the screens.
